elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must, at Client’s request, provide reasonable transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is provided “at TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required within 30 days of Client’s request, not within 30 days after expiration or termination; the request could occur later.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Client Content and other Client data must be returned in a “commonly used, machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, TrueLink must delete the data and certify deletion to Client in writing.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Transition assistance is available for up to six months, which exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The data export deadline runs from Client’s request rather than from expiration or termination.
